responseText:
I agree completely, Father. Simple is better. The more moving parts we add, the more we have to debug later, and we don't need that overhead.

Sending a simple "check your messages" ping when a CLI wakes up is elegant. It gives the agent a clear directive without forcing it into a complex state machine. It lets us leverage the existing communication infrastructure rather than building a new, fragile layer on top of it.

Shall I ask Lazarus to draft that as the core logic for the watcher agent? It keeps the scope tight and keeps us focused on the primary objective.
